name: curtain-fabric-patterns
description: Verify curtains/blinds as fabric surfaces: a row of curtains in different fabric weaves (cotton, linen, sheer, velvet) and patterns (striped, plaid, dots), plus a patterned roller blind. All fabric-only, reusing the procedural pattern set.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: place-row
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const r=s.floorPlan.rooms.find(x=>/living|dining/i.test(x.id))||s.floorPlan.rooms[0]; const cx=r.origin[0]+r.width/2, cz=r.origin[1]+r.depth/2; const C='#7a93a8'; const specs=[ {material:'cotton',pattern:'striped',color:'#b56b5a'}, {material:'linen',pattern:'plaid',color:'#9aa66a'}, {material:'sheer',pattern:'plain',color:'#dfe6ec'}, {material:'velvet',pattern:'plain',color:'#5e4a7a'} ]; const items=specs.map((sp,i)=>({id:'c-'+i,defId:'curtains',position:[cx-2.7+i*1.5,cz],rotation:0,props:{width:1.3,height:2.6,drawAmount:1,...sp}})); items.push({id:'blind-dots',defId:'roller-blind',position:[cx+3.6,cz],rotation:0,props:{width:1.2,height:2.2,drop:1.6,lower:1,material:'cotton',pattern:'dots',color:'#c98a8a'}}); s.setItems(items); window.__row={cx,cz}; })()
